name: Sentence Transformers README (embeddings, retrieval, reranking)
notes: Sentence Transformers README. Four model families: SentenceTransformer (dense), CrossEncoder (reranker), SparseEncoder, MultiVector (ColBERT-style late interaction). Recommends Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.2+, transformers v5.0+. Extras include onnx and openvino. Note the repo redirects to huggingface/sentence-transformers.
